And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Kumar Yadav

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar,J.
Instant Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. (now Section 528 B.N.S.S.) has been preferred by the
petitioner for issuing direction to the learned trial court to decide the Trial No. 885 of 2024 (State
vs. Vakil @ Sonu) pending before Additional District and Sessions Judge, Sultanpur in case crime
no. 49 of 2024, under Sections 323, 366, 376, 506 Ipc, Police Station Bhale Sultan Shahid Smarak,
District Amethi, which is pending since 02.08.2024 i.e. from last about six months.
After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant may
be permitted to withdraw the present Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. (now Section 528
B.N.S.S.) as dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the applicant to approach this Court at the
Moseena Bano vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Prin. Secy. ... on 10 February, 2025

sentences.text: In view of above, the present Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. (now Section 528 B.N.S.S.) is dismissed as not pressed with liberty, as aforesaid.
Office is directed to return the certified copy of the relevant documents to the learned counsel for the applicant after retaining photocopy of the same.
